cases.name: Carolyn Ruth Lieb Killaby
cases.about: She was a medical technician employed by the U.S. military.
cases.caseStatus: CONVICTION; NO BODY CASE; PRISON PAROLEE / ON PROBATION
cases.narrative:
She was intoxicated and seen leaving a bar with him.

He admitted to her murder and, in June 2004, attempted to lead authorities to her body, which he said was on Larch Mountain. A search of the site revealed nothing, however. Late that year, he committed suicide in prison by hanging himself. Carolyn Killaby's body has never been found, but her family erected a headstone in her memory in Lincoln Memorial Park in Portland, Oregon.

cases.name: Erica T. Lucas Jordan
cases.about: She was a Head Start PreK teacher. Her Go Fund Me said, "Erica was a mother, a grandmother, a daughter, a sister, an auntie, a friend, a teacher and so much more than any words can ever capture. Her social media bio reads "I love being a mother. My kids are the best gift I have ever received. I'm a faithful and loyal woman," and those who loved her know there are no truer words. She was taken from us but her love lives in everyone she's ever spoken with, especially her family, her congregation, and her students. She had just received a scholarship for a school administrator program to become a school principal so she could create even more change for the students she loved so much. That's the kind of person she was, always growing, learning, and giving."
